gaps.explanation: Statement p5 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds) total revenues 1,573,573 = General 792,470 + Street 262,264 + Sales Tax 267,573 + Debt Service 227,304 + Other Governmental Funds (Lottery Fund) 23,962. Detail holds the General (pp12-13), Street (p10) and Sales Tax (p11) schedules = 792,470 + 262,264 + 267,573 = 1,322,307. No schedule exists for the Debt Service Fund or the Other Governmental Funds (Lottery Fund) column: Debt Service Property 227,098 + Interest income 206 = 227,304; Lottery Fund Lottery tax 22,287 + Interest income 1,675 = 23,962. 227,304 + 23,962 = 251,266 = gap. Check: 1,322,307 + 251,266 = 1,573,573.

gaps.explanation: Statement p5 Transfers from (to) other funds: General 595,016, Street 349,256, Sales Tax (564,549), Debt Service (363,828), Other Governmental Funds (Lottery Fund) (28,000), Total Governmental Funds (12,105). JSON statement transfers_out = the Total column net 12,105. Detail transfers out 610,549 = Sales Tax -564,549 (p11) + General department General -46,000 (p12). Part 1 (missing fund column): Debt Service (363,828) and Lottery Fund (28,000) transfers out have no schedule; added from p5, detail transfers out = 610,549 + 363,828 + 28,000 = 1,002,377. Part 2 (different basis): detail records transfers gross (General departments in 599,704 + 6,500 + 2,500 + 17,312 + 15,000 = 641,016, Street in 349,256; gross in 990,272), while the Total column nets them: 1,002,377 - 990,272 = 12,105. Remaining difference after the fix 12,105 - 1,002,377 = -990,272 = governmental transfers in netted by the statement; not an error.
